d: The Homeroom Teacher at One International is responsible for creating a positive and engaging educational environment for students in grades K-6. This role involves delivering a comprehensive and dynamic curriculum, fostering student growth in core subjects such as language arts, science, social studies, civics, literature, and math. The teacher will design interactive lesson plans, provide constructive feedback, and ensure the holistic development of students in a nurturing and inclusive setting. The teacher will also be expected to embody and promote the school's core values of Education Excellence, Entrepreneurship, Holistic Wellness, and Culture & Global Insight.
q: Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to connect effectively with students, parents, and colleagues.
Adaptability : Flexibility in adapting to changing priorities, student needs, and educational innovations.
Problem-Solving : Analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of addressing diverse student challenges and needs.
Collaboration : Ability to work collaboratively within a team and contribute to a positive school culture.
Commitment to Excellence : Dedication to professional growth and continuous improvement in teaching practices.
r: Develop and implement a balanced program of instruction, providing opportunities for students to observe, question, and explore, while emphasizing critical thinking and creativity.
Adapt teaching methods and materials to meet diverse student needs and interests, integrating clear objectives into all lessons that encourage lifelong learning.
Use various instructional strategies, including lectures, discussions, and hands-on activities, to engage students and enhance learning experiences.
Continuously update and modify lesson plans throughout the year to align with pacing and student progress.
Monitor and evaluate student performance, behavior, social development, and physical health.
Maintain accurate student records, including grading, portfolios, and other documentation as required by school policies.
Administer standardized tests and interpret results to inform instructional decisions and identify areas for student support.
Establish and enforce classroom rules and procedures to maintain a safe and respectful learning environment.
Create and maintain engaging and informative classroom displays that reflect student work and support the curriculum.
Manage student behavior using positive discipline techniques and approved procedures.
Communicate regularly with parents and guardians about student progress, behavior, and other relevant information.
Organize and participate in parent-teacher conferences, school events, and workshops to build strong relationships with families and engage them in their children's education.
Foster a welcoming environment for parents and guardians, encouraging open communication and collaboration.
Participate in professional development opportunities, educational conferences, and workshops to enhance teaching skills and stay current with educational trends.
Engage in training and development activities arranged by the school for continuous improvement.
Attend and actively participate in staff meetings, curriculum planning sessions, and school committees.
Collaborate with colleagues and administrators in curriculum development, program evaluation, and school-wide initiatives, with a focus on fostering innovation and risk-taking.
Organize and manage classroom resources, including materials and equipment, to support a rich learning environment.
Lead and support extracurricular activities, such as clubs and academic contests, to foster student interests and talents.
Integrate modern technology and digital tools into the classroom to enhance instructional delivery and student engagement.
Foster a culture of innovation and creativity, encouraging students to think critically and solve problems.
Promote mental and physical health and nutrition among students, integrating wellness education into daily routines and activities.
Instill a deep appreciation for Kuwaiti heritage and foster multicultural awareness, preparing students to thrive in a global society.
Participate in a formalized evaluation system that includes classroom observations by administrators, assessments of student progress, and self-reflection.
Performance evaluations will be based on criteria such as instructional effectiveness, classroom management, professional growth, and contributions to the school community.
Engage in community activities, including participation in cultural events and collaboration with local organizations.
Access support systems designed for new teachers, including mentoring programs, orientation sessions, and peer support groups.
Participate in school improvement initiatives, strategic planning, and curriculum review committees.
Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance the school's academic programs and overall educational experience.

The Lead AML Product Specialist, AI & Automation is responsible for improving AML workflows, systems and processes across the AML function.

The role will work closely with AML Operations, Investigations, Transaction Monitoring, KYC/KYB, Compliance, Data and Engineering teams to identify inefficiencies, improve processes and deliver scalable solutions. A key part of the mandate is to embed AI and automation into relevant workstreams, with measurable improvements in productivity, quality and effectiveness.
q: 6+ years of experience in AML, financial crime, compliance technology, product management or a related field.
Strong understanding of AML operations, including transaction monitoring, investigations, KYC/KYB/EDD and suspicious transaction reporting.
Experience improving or implementing AML systems, workflows or operational processes.
Experience working with AI, automation or data-driven solutions.
Strong product management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate AML operational needs into practical technology solutions.
Strong technology mindset and a track record of using new tools to improve how work is performed.
Experience in crypto, payments, fintech or financial services is preferred.
r: Own and prioritise product and process improvement initiatives across AML operations.
Review existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify, automate or improve how work is performed.
Drive end-to-end improvements across transaction monitoring, investigations, KYC/EDD, STR/SAR preparation, sanctions screening and case management.
Work directly with AML teams to understand operational pain points and redesign workflows where appropriate.
Translate AML and regulatory requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering, Data and AI teams.
Develop practical solutions that reduce repetitive manual work and improve the quality and consistency of AML reviews.
Embed AI-enabled tools into relevant AML workflows and ensure they are adopted in day-to-day operations.
Ensure appropriate controls, human review, escalation and auditability are built into new processes.
Track outcomes such as analyst productivity, turnaround time, false-positive reduction, investigation quality and control effectiveness.
Be accountable for demonstrating meaningful application of AI and automation across the AML workstreams under the role’s remit.

Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

d: We are seeking an experienced Saudi National Project Manager -Senior (Offshore) to lead the successful execution of complex offshore oil & gas projects. The incumbent will be responsible for managing projects through all phases of execution, ensuring delivery of safety, quality, schedule, and commercial objectives while maintaining compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Marine, or related discipline).
Master's Degree or MBA is an advantage.
Minimum 10 years of project management experience within the oil & gas industry.
Minimum 5 years of offshore project experience.
Demonstrated experience managing EPC, EPCM, or major capital projects.
Proven track record delivering offshore platforms, subsea systems, offshore pipelines, wellhead facilities, jackets, topsides, or marine infrastructure projects.
Experience working with Saudi Aramco projects is highly preferred.
Strong exposure to brownfield modifications, tie-ins, shutdown activities, and offshore construction campaigns.
Experience managing multinational project teams and multiple contractors simultaneously.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to lead high-performing project teams in challenging environments.
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
Results-oriented with a strong focus on safety, quality, and operational performance
r: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of offshore projects from initiation through commissioning and handover.
Provide overall project leadership and direction to multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, project controls, and HSE.
Manage project scope, budget, schedule, risk, and resource allocation to achieve contractual and operational objectives.
Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco standards, industry regulations, and company procedures.
Oversee offshore construction activities, installation campaigns, hook-up works, commissioning, and start-up activities.
Interface with clients, contractors, consultants, and key stakeholders to ensure alignment on project objectives and execution strategies.
Lead project review meetings, progress reporting, and executive presentations.
Monitor engineering deliverables, procurement activities, and construction progress to ensure milestone achievement.
Drive risk identification, mitigation planning, and resolution of technical and commercial issues.
Ensure implementation of robust HSE programs and maintain a strong safety culture across all project activities.
Manage contractor performance, subcontractor coordination, and commercial obligations.
Support bid reviews, project execution planning, and management of change processes.
Mentor and develop project teams while promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
